about.text: Austria’s whipping cream: at least 30 % fat, or 36 % sold as “extra schlagfähig”, extra whippable.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream standardised to the whipping grade and pasteurised; nothing is cultured. A lexicon gives 36 % as the minimum for pasteurised Schlagobers, which differs from the Codex figure in the about text.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: standardise
steps.note: Cream is standardised to the whipping grade.

steps.name: add
steps.note: The stabiliser carrageenan (E407) is permitted, to stop creaming.
